title: complete refuses a head with an old-name line before any trial
description: On a running test install (temporary Postgres control plane and HTTP server), a worker completing a head that adds an unallowlisted old-name line is refused at complete naming tests/no-old-name.test.ts and its first failing line, leaving the item in build with no merge.trial event; after fixing the line, complete submits.

steps.name: Worker completing a head with an old-name line is refused at complete before any trial
